claims.claim_text: This study evaluates whether Vision Language Models (VLMs) can detect burial mound symbols on Soviet topographic maps. We test **15 hypotheses** about factors that might affect detection performance:

values.quantity: count of hypotheses tested by the study

claims.notes: This summary is 'NOT PART OF THE OSF LODGEMENT' (banner, lines 3-10) and 'must not be cited as the preregistration'; per the v1.1 calibration rule, a claim about what the registration specifies anchors to the lodged document, not this companion. The lodged preregistration.md has 16 '### H<N>:' headings (H1-H15 plus the triggered exploratory H4b); recompute-script needed to exclude H4b and confirm exactly 15 canonical hypotheses (matches §7.1 'Confirmatory Hypotheses (H1-H8)' + §7.2 'Exploratory Hypotheses (H9-H15)').

claims.claim_text: A detection counts as correct if it falls within **20 metres** of a ground truth mound. This tolerance accounts for georeferencing imprecision and symbol size.

claims.notes: Matches osf/preregistration.md line 341 ('Primary matching threshold: 20 metres') and line 294 ('All primary results reported at 20m'). v1.1 calibration rule: registration-specification claim, anchored to the lodged document, not a config. The section heading's 'F1 Score at 20m' (line 36) restates the same figure as a heading label and is not separately extracted.
